title: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
summary: An open-source orchestration system for AI agents (Claude Code, Codex) that automates the full lifecycle: intake from issues, execution in isolated K8s pods, PR monitoring, self-healing, and merge completion.

title: Agent Package Manager (APM) for Agent Configuration
summary: Microsoft/GitHub's open-source CLI for managing AI agent dependencies (plugins, skills, rules) with lockfiles and security audits. Focuses on the 'Agent Supply Chain' security and portability across agent runtimes (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot).

title: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
summary: A comprehensive security/governance tool for agentic workflows. Features static/behavioral analysis, red teaming, and runtime monitoring. Explicitly supports OpenClaw gateway hardening and SKILL.md analysis.

title: Workflow setup to make your coding agent ship small reviewable PRs incrementally
summary: Developers are struggling with the 'Reviewability Crisis': AI agents tend to dump massive, mixed-responsibility PRs (schema + logic + routes) that are nearly impossible for humans to review safely.

title: Nia (YC S25) – Give better context to coding agents
summary: A context layer/indexing service (via MCP) for coding agents to stop hallucinations by providing grounded, up-to-date context from real codebases and docs.

title: Urlx – an agent-made Rust replacement for curl/libcurl
summary: Demonstration of agents (Claude Code) being used to rapidly reimplement complex, widely deployed software (curl) by using its test suite as a specification. Passes 100% of applicable curl tests.

title: SHTMLs – HTML pastebin where the AI uploads its own output
summary: Explores the 'llms.txt self-configuration pattern' where agents autonomously read API docs and configure themselves to use external tools/storage.
